entry.en: Your passport should be valid for the duration of your stay in Georgia.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda tu estancia en Georgia.
entry.quote: your passport should be valid for the duration of your stay

entry.en: All visitors must have appropriate health and accident insurance covering all healthcare needs during their visit.
entry.es: Todos los visitantes deben tener un seguro médico y de accidentes adecuado que cubra todas sus necesidades sanitarias durante la visita.
entry.quote: All visitors must have appropriate health and accident insurance to cover all healthcare needs during your visit.

entry.en: The insurance coverage amount must be no less than 30,000 Georgian Lari.
entry.es: El monto de cobertura del seguro no debe ser inferior a 30.000 laris georgianos.
entry.quote: The insurance coverage amount must be no less than 30 000 Georgian Lari.

entry.en: Georgia has a very strict anti-drugs policy that covers prescription and non-prescription medicines.
entry.es: Georgia tiene una política antidrogas muy estricta que abarca medicamentos con y sin receta.
entry.quote: Georgia has a very strict anti-drugs policy. This covers prescription and non-prescription medicines commonly available in the UK.

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Debes declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

entry.en: Foreign nationals who want to work in Georgia, including remotely or running a business, must have a work permit.
entry.es: Los extranjeros que quieran trabajar en Georgia, incluso a distancia o gestionando un negocio, deben tener un permiso de trabajo.
entry.quote: If you are a foreign national and want to work in Georgia, including working remotely or running a business, you must have a work permit.

safety.en: Demonstrations in Tbilisi are mainly focused on the Parliament building on Rustaveli Avenue but can spread to other areas.
safety.es: Las manifestaciones en Tiflis se concentran sobre todo en el Parlamento, en la avenida Rustaveli, pero pueden extenderse a otras zonas.
safety.quote: In Tbilisi the demonstrations are now mainly focused on the Parliament building on Rustaveli Avenue, but they can spread to other areas

safety.en: The FCDO advises against all travel to the Russian-occupied regions of South Ossetia and Abkhazia for security reasons.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a las regiones ocupadas por Rusia de Osetia del Sur y Abjasia por motivos de seguridad.
safety.quote:
South Ossetia and Abkhazia

For security reasons, FCDO advises against all travel to the Russian occupied regions of:

safety.en: Take sensible precautions against pickpocketing, particularly in crowded places.
safety.es: Toma precauciones razonables contra los carteristas, sobre todo en lugares concurridos.
safety.quote: take sensible precautious to avoid pick-pocketing, particularly in crowded places

safety.en: There have been reports of drink spiking in Georgia, so be wary of strangers who approach you to take you to a restaurant or nightclub.
safety.es: Se han reportado casos de bebidas adulteradas en Georgia, así que desconfía de desconocidos que te inviten a un restaurante o club nocturno.
safety.quote: There have been reports of drink spiking in Georgia. Be wary of strangers approaching you to take you to a restaurant or nightclub.

safety.en: Those perceived as part of or supporting the LGBT+ community may face harassment and assault.
safety.es: Quienes sean percibidos como parte de la comunidad LGBT+ o como sus aliados pueden sufrir acoso y agresiones.
safety.quote: Those perceived as being part of or supporting the LGBT+ community may face harassment and assault.

safety.en: Roads outside city centres are often badly lit and of poor quality.
safety.es: Las carreteras fuera de los centros urbanos suelen estar mal iluminadas y ser de mala calidad.
safety.quote: roads outside city centres are often badly lit and poor quality

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Georgia, including Gudauri ski resort, Mount Kazbegi and Mount Tetnuldi.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en partes de Georgia, como la estación de esquí de Gudauri, el monte Kazbegi y el monte Tetnuldi.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Georgia, including Gudauri ski resort, Mount Kazbegi, and Mount Tetnuldi.

health.en: Rabies is a health risk, with treatment available in Tbilisi and major towns, and dog bites or scratches need immediate medical attention.
health.es: La rabia es un riesgo; hay tratamiento en Tiflis y las ciudades principales, y las mordeduras o arañazos de perro requieren atención médica inmediata.
health.quote: rabies – treatment is available in Tbilisi and major towns. If you’re bitten or scratched by a dog, get medical attention immediately.

health.en: Medical facilities in Tbilisi are available but can be expensive, and they are limited outside Tbilisi.
health.es: Hay centros médicos en Tiflis pero pueden ser caros, y fuera de Tiflis son limitados.
health.quote: Medical facilities in Tbilisi are available but can be expensive. Outside Tbilisi, medical facilities are limited.

health.en: Water quality varies, and bottled water is widely available.
health.es: La calidad del agua varía y el agua embotellada está ampliamente disponible.
health.quote: varying water quality – bottled water is widely available

health.en: Venomous vipers are a risk, particularly in early summer, and few medical facilities outside major towns have anti-venom.
health.es: Las víboras venenosas son un riesgo, sobre todo a principios del verano, y pocos centros médicos fuera de las ciudades principales tienen antiveneno.
health.quote: venomous snakes (vipers), particularly in early summer – few medical facilities outside major towns have anti-venom

health.en: Giardia is a common issue for foreign visitors.
health.es: La giardia es un problema común entre los visitantes extranjeros.
health.quote: Giardia is a common issue for foreign visitors.

help.en: The emergency number is 112 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias es el 112 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.
help.es: Marca el 112 y pide una ambulancia.
help.quote: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.

getting_in.en: Kutaisi has numerous Wizzair flights from many European destinations, including London Luton, Berlin and Milan Malpensa.
getting_in.es: Kutaisi tiene numerosos vuelos de Wizzair desde muchos destinos europeos, entre ellos Londres Luton, Berlín y Milán Malpensa.
getting_in.quote: Kutaisi has numerous flights with Wizzair from many European destinations, including London Luton, Berlin Schönefeld, Milan Malpensa, Budapest, Prague, and Brussels Charleroi.

getting_in.en: Tbilisi has flights from a number of European and Gulf cities, including London Gatwick, Amsterdam Schiphol and Vienna.
getting_in.es: Tiflis tiene vuelos desde varias ciudades europeas y del Golfo, entre ellas Londres Gatwick, Ámsterdam Schiphol y Viena.
getting_in.quote: There are flights to Tbilisi from a number of European and Gulf cities, including London Gatwick, Amsterdam Schiphol, Vienna

getting_in.en: Turkish Airlines flies every day between Batumi and Istanbul.
getting_in.es: Turkish Airlines vuela todos los días entre Batumi y Estambul.
getting_in.quote: Turkish Airlines fly every day between Batumi and Istanbul.

getting_in.en: Georgia considers the crossings from Russia into South Ossetia (Roki Tunnel) and Abkhazia (Psou River) illegal.
getting_in.es: Georgia considera ilegales los cruces desde Rusia hacia Osetia del Sur (túnel de Roki) y Abjasia (río Psou).
getting_in.quote: The crossings from Russia into South Ossetia (the Roki Tunnel) and Abkhazia (Psou River between Gantiadi and Adler) are considered illegal by Georgia.

getting_in.en: There are direct bus services from Istanbul that terminate in Tbilisi.
getting_in.es: Hay autobuses directos desde Estambul que terminan en Tiflis.
getting_in.quote: There are direct bus services from Istanbul, Turkey, which stop at various places en route and terminate in Tbilisi.

getting_in.en: A sleeper train from Yerevan, Armenia runs every other day, and daily in summer.
getting_in.es: Un tren cama desde Ereván, Armenia, circula día por medio y a diario en verano.
getting_in.quote: There is a sleeper service every other day (daily in the summer) from Yerevan, Armenia operated by South Caucasus Railways

getting_around.en: A marshrutka, essentially a minibus, is the most common way to travel and runs on established routes.
getting_around.es: La marshrutka, básicamente una minivan, es la forma más común de viajar y opera en rutas establecidas.
getting_around.quote: A marshrutka (from Russian: маршрутка, plural marshrutki; Georgian: მარშუტკა or მარშრუტკა), which essentially is a minibus, is the most common way to travel and operate on established routes.

getting_around.en: Marshrutkas mostly run in the morning and become sparse in the afternoon, so start early.
getting_around.es: Las marshrutkas circulan sobre todo por la mañana y escasean por la tarde, así que conviene salir temprano.
getting_around.quote: Start early, because marshrutkas mostly run in the morning and become sparse in the afternoon.

getting_around.en: The Tbilisi-Batumi train is one of the most popular routes and takes approximately 5 hours.
getting_around.es: El tren Tiflis-Batumi es una de las rutas más populares y tarda aproximadamente 5 horas.
getting_around.quote: One of the most popular routes is the Tbilisi-Batumi train, which takes passengers through the scenic Georgian countryside and offers stunning views of the Black Sea coast. The journey takes approximately 5 hours

getting_around.en: Ride-hailing services Bolt, Maxim, Yandex.Taxi and gg taxi are very popular and convenient in cities.
getting_around.es: Los servicios de transporte por app Bolt, Maxim, Yandex.Taxi y gg taxi son muy populares y cómodos en las ciudades.
getting_around.quote: The ride hailing services Bolt (in Batumi, Kutaisi, Tbilisi), Maxim (Batumi, Gori, Kobuleti, Kutaisi, Poti, Rustavi, Tbilisi, Zestafoni, Zugdidi), Yandex.Taxi and gg taxi are very popular and convenient in cities.

getting_around.en: It is advised to negotiate the price before getting into a taxi because there is no official taxi meter.
getting_around.es: Se aconseja negociar el precio antes de subir a un taxi porque no hay taxímetro oficial.
getting_around.quote: It is advised to negotiate a price before getting into a taxi. There is no official "taxi-meter", despite websites claiming otherwise.

getting_around.en: Roads between Tbilisi and other major cities are typically in good condition, but country roads are often in disrepair.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras entre Tiflis y otras ciudades grandes suelen estar en buen estado, pero las rurales a menudo están deterioradas.
getting_around.quote: Roads connecting Tbilisi and other major cities are typically smooth and in good condition, but country roads are often in disrepair.

money.en: The national currency is the Georgian lari (GEL).
money.es: La moneda nacional es el lari georgiano (GEL).
money.quote: The national currency is the Georgian lari (ISO currency code: GEL)

money.en: Prices may be quoted in US dollars and euros, but goods and services must be paid for in lari.
money.es: Los precios pueden indicarse en dólares y euros, pero los bienes y servicios deben pagarse en laris.
money.quote: Prices may be quoted in US dollars and euros, but goods and services must be paid for in local currency (lari).

money.en: ATMs are available countrywide and generally accept Mastercard and Visa cards.
money.es: Hay cajeros en todo el país y por lo general aceptan tarjetas Mastercard y Visa.
money.quote: ATMs are available countrywide and generally accept cards from both Mastercard and Visa.

money.en: Outside major towns you may not find ATMs or be able to use cards, so take enough lari cash to rural or remote areas.
money.es: Fuera de las ciudades principales quizá no haya cajeros ni se puedan usar tarjetas, así que lleva suficientes laris en efectivo a zonas rurales o remotas.
money.quote: Outside major towns, you may not find ATMs or be able to use credit and debit cards. Take enough cash in lari if travelling to rural or remote areas.

money.en: Tipping is common in Western-style restaurants in the capital but almost never expected in more traditional establishments.
money.es: La propina es común en restaurantes de estilo occidental en la capital, pero casi nunca se espera en establecimientos más tradicionales.
money.quote: Tipping is common in Western-style restaurants in the capital, but almost never expected in more traditional establishments.

money.en: Many restaurants, especially in big cities, add a 10% service charge.
money.es: Muchos restaurantes, sobre todo en las grandes ciudades, añaden un cargo por servicio del 10%.
money.quote: In many restaurants, especially in big cities, there is a 10% service charge.

etiquette.en: Georgians are generally friendly and very hospitable, and a Georgian who invites you somewhere will often pick up the tab.
etiquette.es: Los georgianos suelen ser amables y muy hospitalarios, y quien te invita a algún sitio suele pagar la cuenta.
etiquette.quote: Georgians in general are friendly, and they are hospitable to a fault. If a Georgian invites you somewhere, they will often pick up the tab.

etiquette.en: Georgia is a conservative Christian society, and women must veil before entering a church.
etiquette.es: Georgia es una sociedad cristiana conservadora y las mujeres deben cubrirse la cabeza antes de entrar en una iglesia.
etiquette.quote: Georgia is still a conservative Christian society, and it is mandatory for women to veil before entering a church.

etiquette.en: Abkhazia and South Ossetia are sensitive topics with virtually no safe middle ground, so the guide says not to bring them up.
etiquette.es: Abjasia y Osetia del Sur son temas delicados sin prácticamente ningún punto medio seguro, por lo que la guía recomienda no sacarlos.
etiquette.quote: There is virtually no "safe middle ground" position in these topics, so just don't bring them up.

etiquette.en: Be very cautious when talking about Russia.
etiquette.es: Ten mucho cuidado al hablar de Rusia.
etiquette.quote: Be very cautious when talking about Russia.

etiquette.en: Taking pictures inside churches is not welcome, and photographing a priest in a church is an offence.
etiquette.es: No se acepta tomar fotos dentro de las iglesias, y fotografiar a un sacerdote en una iglesia es un delito.
etiquette.quote: Taking picture inside of churches is not welcome, and taking a picture of a priest in churches is an offence and even a crime.

etiquette.en: Outside cities, be aware of cultural sensitivities around modest dress, particularly in places of worship, and public affection.
etiquette.es: Fuera de las ciudades, ten en cuenta la sensibilidad cultural sobre la vestimenta modesta, sobre todo en lugares de culto, y las muestras de afecto en público.
etiquette.quote: When travelling outside cities, be aware of cultural sensitivities around modest dress (particularly in places of worship) and showing affection in public.

connectivity.en: SIM cards are given out for free at Tbilisi airport.
connectivity.es: En el aeropuerto de Tiflis se entregan tarjetas SIM gratis.
connectivity.quote: SIM cards are given out for free at Tbilisi airport.

connectivity.en: A Magti eSIM costs 10 lari and can be installed with the MyMagti app before arriving in Georgia.
connectivity.es: Una eSIM de Magti cuesta 10 laris y se puede instalar con la app MyMagti antes de llegar a Georgia.
connectivity.quote: An eSIM costs 10 lari by itself and can be installed using the MyMagti app (iPhone) before you arrive in Georgia.

connectivity.en: Magti is reported to have the best coverage but might be slightly more expensive.
connectivity.es: Se dice que Magti tiene la mejor cobertura, pero puede ser algo más cara.
connectivity.quote: Magti — is reported to have the best coverage, but might be slightly more expensive.

connectivity.en: Accommodations, airlines, drivers and restaurants universally use WhatsApp (usually), or Viber, Facebook Messenger or Telegram.
connectivity.es: Alojamientos, aerolíneas, conductores y restaurantes usan universalmente WhatsApp (normalmente), Viber, Facebook Messenger o Telegram.
connectivity.quote: Communication with accommodations, airlines, drivers, restaurants, tourist information and so on, universally use WhatsApp (usually), or Viber, Facebook Messenger, or Telegram.

connectivity.en: Tbilisi has a free Wi-Fi network named "Tbilisi Loves You", but it frequently does not work.
connectivity.es: Tiflis tiene una red wifi gratuita llamada "Tbilisi Loves You", pero con frecuencia no funciona.
connectivity.quote: There is a free Wi-Fi network all over Tbilisi named "Tbilisi Loves You", including the airport. However, it frequently does not work, getting stuck on the login pages.

connectivity.en: Hostels and hotels usually have free Wi-Fi for their guests, even in Mestia.
connectivity.es: Los hostales y hoteles suelen ofrecer wifi gratis a sus huéspedes, incluso en Mestia.
connectivity.quote: Hostels and hotels usually have free Wi-Fi for their guests, even in Mestia.
